0: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI run the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rHeads up, these challenges\nis for one Hustler. Solo dolo.\r
2:
At the Battle Hall, you can run
Single or Double challenges solo.For Single Battles, you roll
in with one homie at least Lv. 30.Double Battles need you to
roll in with two of the same kind of homie, both at least Lv. 30.Win-streak records get kept for
each kind of homie.So ANY homie can go for
no. 1.When you walk in the Hall, you
pick the type and rank of the homies you wanna scrap.Win ten in a row, and you
get Battle Points (BP).If you wanna dip mid-run,
save the game first.If you don't save, you
gettin' disqualified. No cap.Don't say I ain't warn you!

Grass type AND a Flying type.Me?You could think of me as...

66: A lil advice...\rAt the Battle Hall, the other side's\nhomies match your level.\rThat way, you can pick any of your\nhomies without trippin' about\ftheir levels.
67: The Battle Hall keep your\nwin-streak records.\fThat's dope, huh?\r...Wait a sec!\rMe and my homie can start runs\nwith the same setup and see who\fcan stretch their win streak\fthe longest.\fThat's even MORE fun!
